name: Israel at Baal-peor
charge: Fornication with the daughters of Moab; sacrificing to their gods
summary: In Shittim the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab, who called them to the sacrifices of their gods. Israel ate, bowed down, and joined himself unto Baal-peor. The plague took twenty-four thousand.
offense: Balaam's counsel executed: sexual sin as the door to idol worship. Hosea says they went to Baal-peor and separated themselves unto that shame, and their abominations were according as they loved. Psalm 106 adds that they ate the sacrifices of the dead.
judgment: The Lord commanded the heads of the offenders hanged up before the sun, and the judges to slay every man his men that were joined to Baal-peor. A plague ran through the camp until Phinehas stayed it. Paul: fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

lawsResolved.text: Anyone that has served or worshipped false or pagan gods shall be put to death.
It is the will of God that you abstain from fornication and sexual immorality.
Do not covenant with the heathen or their gods, or keep company with the heathen and idolaters.
We are not to intermarry with those who practice idolatry.
Death penalty is to be given to idolaters.
A church is not to have those within it who hold to the doctrine of Balaam.

text.text: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.
And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.
And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal–peor.
And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal–peor: for all the men that followed Baal–peor, the Lord thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal–peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
